Description: The Queue is a reactive queue that a host component creates for itself and keeps in a private field. It holds items with an id and a priority, hands them out in order, keeps them in IndexedDB so they survive a reload, and dispatches an event for every change. It is an EventTarget-based add-on rather than a custom element: it declares no Tag, Composition or Gestures. An item is the host's own object, `{ id, priority } & T`: the queue owns `id` and `priority`, and keeps every other field as the host gave it.

waiting.description: The items that wait to be handed out, as a list of `Item`, in the order `take()` hands them out: the order they were added, or, in a priority queue, the highest `priority` first and the earliest added first among equals. An item that is put back or changed keeps the place its first addition gave it. Each item is the stored, frozen copy.

add.description: Puts an item at its place among the waiting items. Its `priority` is 1 when it has none. Throws `Invalid item value: <value>` for a value that is not an object, `Invalid item value: id is required` or `id is invalid` for an id that is absent or not a non-empty string, `Invalid item value: priority is invalid` for a priority that is not a whole number from 1 to 10, and `Invalid item value: id is already in the queue` for an id the queue holds, waiting or being worked on.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The item to add: the host's object with an `id` that is unique in the queue, an optional `priority` from 1 (lowest) to 10 (highest), and any other fields of the host's own.

onadd.description: Dispatched when an item is added.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Contains the item as the queue holds it.
